replies.body:
Well, I have a headset called the "SkullCandy SLYR" it's compatible with: Xbox, PSN, And laptops. The built in mic also has a good reach to your mouth. (Not to close or too far).
$$$$$101$$$$ ($)

hope this helped!

replies.author: hasl
replies.body:
You broke a $60 headset? Nice...
I use the Turtle Beach Pla (http://www.amazon.co.uk/PLa-Playstation-3-Headset-EU/dp/B008HB4GZE) is says it's for PS3, but I'm a rebel. It's great for the price, but if you really want outstanding quality, then invest in one of the other headsets listed above. I'm use that purely for TeamSpeak.
For listening to music, Beats by Dre Studio. Yes it's not the cheapest set of noise makers, but trust me. It's. Worth. It.
(http://uk.beatsbydre.com/headphones/studio/titanium/900-00188-31-uk.html).
